en.title: Find the Wrong Digit Index in a Sum
en.description:
Compare the decimal digits of num1+num2 and givenSum, numbering positions from 0 starting at the ones digit; missing higher digits are treated as 0. Return the index of the first differing digit, or −1 if they are identical.

The standard input/output format and any supplementary ranges on this site are as stated in this problem.
en.input: One line with three non-negative integers num1 num2 givenSum, each ≤10^18.
en.output: Output the index of the first mismatched digit, or -1.
en.explanation: Compare the ones digits of the two numbers digit by digit, then integer-divide each by 10; return the current index at the first difference.
hints: Compare the ones digits of the two numbers digit by digit, then integer-divide each by 10; return the current index at the first difference.
